text:
Eli (AE): @here Peregrine Health just sent back the security questionnaire and a long list of auth requirements. They want to kick off a POC next week but need clarity on SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC mapping, and domain verification before we lock dates. I pasted the key asks below — can folks confirm what we can commit for the POC?

- SAML 2.0 (SP and IdP initiated)
- Dynamic IdP metadata URL or uploaded XML
- Cert rotation policy / support for multiple certs
- SCIM v2 push provisioning with group sync and delta support
- Role mapping via SCIM groups + ability to create custom roles
- Domain ownership proof (DNS TXT) + block on-account-creation for unverified domains
- Audit logs for provisioning and SSO assertions (90d retention)

Maya (SE): We can cover most of that in hosted POC: SAML 2.0 SP and IdP-initiated are supported. We accept either an IdP metadata URL or an uploaded XML blob. Cert rotation: we support certificate rollover with overlapping certs so rolling doesn't break sessions.

Maya (SE): Quick config snippet for their IdP team — they asked for attributes:

```
Assertion attributes we expect: email (NameID/email), given_name, family_name, groups
Audience: urn:redwood:saml
NameID format: transient or email
```

Maya (SE): For SCIM: we support SCIM v2 push (POST/PUT/PATCH) and we do delta sync (changes only). Group nesting: we don't support nested groups server-side; we'll flatten incoming groups and attach them to the user. If they need nested semantics we can add a small mapping script in the POC to emulate.

Ben (Eng): From infra side, note two enterprise blockers we saw in questionnaire: Peregrine requires KMS-backed encryption with customer-managed keys + VPC-for-control-plane for auditability. Hosted POC can run with our default KMS, but for production they'll push for Private/VPC deployment. Flagging as an escalation if sales expects enterprise pricing.

Eli (AE): @Ben understood. For POC they said they'd accept hosted if we sign an NDA and provide KMS attestation, but long term they want Private. Can we get a short statement from security about KMS options for the POC?

Jules (InfoSec): We can provide a KMS attestation PDF for the POC (uses our cloud KMS, with 256-bit AES at rest). For customer-managed keys (BYOK/HSM) we require Private deployment and formal onboarding; that’s a separate engagement. Also audit logs: we can export SSO/scim events to a customer log sink (S3/Kinesis) in Private, hosted retains logs for 90 days and we can provide extracts on request.

Jules (InfoSec): Quick answers to questionnaire items they highlighted:
- Encryption at rest: AES-256, TLS1.2+ in transit
- SAML assertion lifetime: default 5 minutes, configurable per-tenant for Private
- User provisioning audit trail: available, includes actor, timestamp, source (SCIM/API)
- Pen test / SOC door: we can share SOC2 report after NDA

Tina (CS): Customer contact (Peregrine): 
- Emily Park (IT Security)
- Jason Liu (Platform)
They asked for a sample SCIM attribute mapping doc and a small test account to exercise group sync. I can share a temporary org for the POC.

Maya (SE): I'll drop a sample mapping and a test SCIM webhook URL. Also will provide a minimal playbook to validate SSO+SCIM end-to-end:
1) Upload IdP metadata / configure SP settings
2) Perform IdP-initiated sign-in, check NameID and attributes
3) Create user in IdP with groups -> verify SCIM push creates user + attaches groups
4) Update group membership in IdP -> verify delta sync updates roles
5) Test login block for unverified domain (we can toggle this in tenant settings)

Ben (Eng): Pricing note for SE/sales: POC on hosted: we can cover up to ~2M tokens and standard infra for free credits; if they require Private/VPC + BYOK we need to scope Dedicated/Private and that will be a quote (baseline reserved capacity + onboarding). I'll DM @Eli a rough quote range.

Eli (AE): Perfect. Two asks before I reply to Emily: 1) A short doc attesting hosted KMS + log retention (for their legal/security team), 2) A SCIM attribute-mapping example and the playbook. @Maya @Jules can you deliver both by EOD PST today?

Maya (SE): Yep — I'll drop the SCIM mapping in this thread in 2 hours.

Jules (InfoSec): I'll assemble the attestation and SOC2 gating notes, should have a signed PDF ready for you by 5pm PT.

deploy-bot: Created temporary POC org redwood-peregrine-2026 and seeded test user (emily.test@peregrine.health). Credentials posted to 1:1.

Eli (AE): Thanks all. I'll coordinate calendar with Peregrine for next Tue and include the playbook. If any of the config limits (nested groups, BYOK) need engineering time for the POC, flag now so we can set expectations.

Ben (Eng): If they push nested groups as a blocker we can do a quick mapping script during the POC (1-2 dev days). BYOK is non-trivial — requires Private and legal/infra onboarding.

Tina (CS): I'll set up the walkthrough and send invites after we have the attestation doc.

Eli (AE): Great — marking actionable items: SCIM mapping (Maya), KMS attestation (Jules), provisional quote for Private (Ben). Will update Peregrine after we collect docs. :thumbsup:
